operations.name: Clear Messages
operations.notes: DELETE /{account}/{queue}/messages removes every message and returns 204. A service SAS cannot grant this operation; an account SAS needs the d permission on the object resource type.

operations.name: Create Queue
operations.notes: PUT /{account}/{queue}. 201 for a new queue, 204 when the queue exists with identical metadata, 409 QueueAlreadyExists when metadata differs. Queue names follow Azure rules (3-63 chars; length failures are OutOfRangeInput, character failures InvalidResourceName). Metadata names must be identifiers and total at most 8 KiB. Metadata names are returned lower-cased because HTTP header names are case-insensitive.

operations.name: Delete Message
operations.notes: DELETE /{account}/{queue}/messages/{messageid}?popreceipt= returns 204. A missing or expired message or stale issued pop receipt returns 404 MessageNotFound, verified for stale receipts at 2023-11-03. Malformed Base64 is 400 InvalidQueryParameterValue; missing popreceipt is 400 MissingRequiredQueryParameter. A service SAS needs the p permission.

operations.name: Delete Queue
operations.notes: DELETE /{account}/{queue} returns 204 and removes the queue with its messages immediately; Azure's garbage-collection window (QueueBeingDeleted) is not modeled, so the name can be recreated at once.

operations.name: Get Messages
operations.notes: GET /{account}/{queue}/messages with numofmessages 1-32 (default 1) and visibilitytimeout 1-604800 (default 30). Each returned message gets a new pop receipt, an incremented DequeueCount and a new visibility time in one transaction. Messages are served in insertion order, which Azure does not guarantee. A service SAS needs the p permission.

operations.name: Get Queue ACL
operations.notes: GET /{account}/{queue}?comp=acl returns the stored SignedIdentifiers with times normalized to seven fractional digits. The 2023-11-03 recording checks an empty ACL on a fresh queue using bearer authorization. A service SAS cannot grant this operation.

operations.name: Get Queue Metadata
operations.notes: GET or HEAD /{account}/{queue}?comp=metadata returns x-ms-meta-* and x-ms-approximate-messages-count, which is exact locally (all unexpired messages, visible or not). A service SAS needs the r permission.

operations.name: Get Queue Service Properties
operations.notes: GET /{account}?restype=service&comp=properties returns the stored Logging, HourMetrics, MinuteMetrics and Cors sections or local defaults. The recorded bearer profile has disabled logging, metrics and retention and no CORS rules; it does not establish Azure defaults. Not available to a service SAS.

operations.name: Get Queue Service Stats
operations.notes: Served on the single local endpoint rather than a -secondary read-access geo-replicated endpoint; always reports GeoReplication Status live with LastSyncTime set to the current clock time.

operations.name: List Queues
operations.notes: GET /{account}?comp=list with prefix, marker, maxresults (1-5000, otherwise 400 OutOfRangeQueryParameterValue) and include=metadata. Queues are ordered by name. Markers are opaque local tokens, not Azure marker strings. ServiceEndpoint is the local path-style URL.

operations.name: Peek Messages
operations.notes: GET /{account}/{queue}/messages?peekonly=true with numofmessages 1-32 returns visible messages without changing state and without PopReceipt or TimeNextVisible. A service SAS needs the r permission.

operations.name: Preflight Queue Request
operations.notes: OPTIONS on any queue URL. Matches Origin, Access-Control-Request-Method and Access-Control-Request-Headers (exact or trailing-wildcard patterns) against the stored CORS rules. The 2023-11-03 anonymous recording without CORS rules checks 403 CorsPreflightFailure and 400 InvalidHeaderValue for missing Origin or Access-Control-Request-Method, with MessageDetails in the XML. Successful preflight is not recorded.

operations.name: Put Message
operations.notes: POST /{account}/{queue}/messages returns 201 with MessageId, InsertionTime, ExpirationTime, PopReceipt and TimeNextVisible. visibilitytimeout 0-604800 and messagettl >= 1 or -1 (never expires, reported as 9999-12-31); visibilitytimeout must be below messagettl. Bearer recordings at 2023-11-03 verify successful writes with ordinary, delayed and short-TTL messages, 413 RequestBodyTooLarge for 65537 bytes of ASCII MessageText and 400 OutOfRangeQueryParameterValue for visibilitytimeout=604801. Base64 encoding is a client concern. A service SAS needs the a permission.

operations.name: Set Queue ACL
operations.notes: PUT /{account}/{queue}?comp=acl stores up to 5 unique signed identifiers (id up to 64 chars, permissions a subset of raup in order, ISO 8601 UTC times) and returns 204; an empty body clears them. Stored policies are honoured by service SAS tokens that carry si.

operations.name: Set Queue Metadata
operations.notes: PUT /{account}/{queue}?comp=metadata replaces all metadata and returns 204; sending no x-ms-meta-* headers clears it. A service SAS cannot grant this operation.

operations.name: Set Queue Service Properties
operations.notes: PUT /{account}?restype=service&comp=properties returns 202. Partial bodies replace only the sections sent; CORS (up to 5 rules) is evaluated for preflight and normal requests. Logging and metrics settings are stored and returned but no analytics logs or metrics are produced, and $logs/$metrics tables are not created.

operations.name: Update Message
operations.notes: PUT /{account}/{queue}/messages/{messageid}?popreceipt=&visibilitytimeout= (0-604800, required) with an optional QueueMessage body returns 204 with new x-ms-popreceipt and x-ms-time-next-visible. Empty body keeps the text. Stale issued receipts return 404 MessageNotFound. The new visibility time is not capped at the message expiry. A service SAS needs the u permission.
